relations.statement: Gamma38 = Sigma36 ⊔ Marks2 with Sigma36 ∩ Marks2 = ∅, so card Gamma38 = card Sigma36 + card Marks2
relations.hypotheses: Sigma36 and Marks2 are finite and disjoint

relations.statement: An encoded relation E ⊆ V×V, a rewrite relation and an observation map q: V→O are separate data; none is defined from another without an explicit declaration

lemmas.statement: In raw_glyphs, < and > carry no balanced-pairing axiom; pairing is not derivable from the alphabet alone

near_misses.claim: The alphabet size 38 determines the atlas row or Genesis stage
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Alphabet size is independent of atlas row and Genesis stage

near_misses.claim: < and > must be balanced in raw_glyphs
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: raw_glyphs treats the marks as ordinary glyphs, so balance is not an axiom

near_misses.claim: The word production ranges over all 38 symbols
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The word production uses Sigma36 only, which excludes < and >

open_obligations: No existing declarations were provided, so every reference is proposed_new

Role assignment to glyphs needs a grammar, which is not given
